theorem lg_target {α : Type u_2} [Field α] [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] : Archimedean α := by
  constructor
  intro x
  intro h
  by_contra h'
  have this : (supr (fun x => (x : α)) : α) ≤ x := le_supr (fun x => (x : α)) h'
  rw [le_supr] at this
  apply le_antisymm
  exact h
  exact this
